messages:
Anna: Heads-up — saw a ~12% p99 bump for INT4 on sm94 after the kernel-pick heuristic change yesterday. Traces point to KV fetch stalls and more slot eviction churn. Anyone else?
Ben: I reproduced on the long-prefix bench. Seqlen around 512-1024 shows KV hit ratio dropping ~20%. Shorter seqs look fine.
Kevin: Posting the pick log + profiler snippet I captured. infra-bot: uploading attachments...
Kevin: ```
PICK_DECISION log:
model=redwood-v1 quant=int4 arch=sm94 seq_len=600
kernels=[kA_score=0.68,kB_score=0.72,kC_score=0.55] selected=kB (slot=3)
kv_slot_evicted=slot5 occupancy_after=0.62
latency_breakdown: kv_wait=24ms, kernel_exec=38ms, scheduling=6ms
```
Shayla: Looks like the slot_score formula is letting slightly higher kernel_score override a hot-slot occupancy penalty. Current formula: `slot_score = kernel_score + arch_bias - eviction_penalty * slot_occupancy`. eviction_penalty might be too small for sm94/int4 shapes.
Ben: Agreed. I ran a quick sim where eviction_penalty * 2 reduced churn but increased kernel_switches. Also saw cold-start tail because selected kernel wasn't warmed.
Anna: Two-pronged fix suggestion: 1) per-arch/int quant bias tuning to prefer kernels with better kv-behavior for mid-long seqs, 2) occupancy smoothing + hysteresis to avoid flip-flopping.
Shayla: Proposed autotune knobs (quick patch):
```json
{
  "seqlen_buckets": [0, 64, 256, 512, 1024],
  "kernel_bias": {"sm94": {"int4": 0.15, "int8": 0.0, "fp8": -0.05}},
  "kv_slot_eviction": "LRU_SEGMENTED",
  "occupancy_smoothing_alpha": 0.2,
  "hysteresis_ms": 30
}
```
Ben: I applied the bias tweak + alpha=0.2 on a local canary. Results: p99 from 198ms -> 172ms, p95 ~ stable, kv_hit_ratio improved ~12%. But cold-start p99 for some workloads went up ~6ms (kernel warmup).
Kevin: For warmup we should preheat kernels when the selected kernel differs from previous for same model-id+prefix. Suggest `warmup_kick=true, warmup_prefill=8`. That reduces the cold-start bump in my experiments.
Anna: Can we do a short A/B rollout? 10% traffic with these knobs for 48h. Collect metrics: p50/p95/p99, kv_hit_ratio, kernel_switch_rate, cold_start_p99.
Ben: I'll bake the config into a canary bundle and add probe dashboards.
Shayla: Quick note for autotuner: add a penalty term that scales with seq_len bucket for int4 when seq_len > 256 (prefer int8 for >512 unless kernel_score delta > 0.2). This keeps int4 for short tasks but avoids mid-long pathological picks.
Kevin: Example pseudo-rule: `if (quant==int4 && seq_len_bucket>=2) score -= seq_len_penalty[seq_len_bucket]` where seq_len_penalty = [0, 0.05, 0.12, 0.20].
Anna: @Ben @Kevin please create the canary PR and attach the bench results. I'll own the rollout + alert thresholds.
infra-bot: Canary scheduled: canary_id=cr-233210-canary1, rollout=10%, duration=48h, owner=Anna
Ben: PR opened: `runtime: autotune/sm94-int4-kvbias` — bench logs in CI.
Shayla: Thanks — if we still see spot regressions we can add a short-term hard rule to avoid kernel kB for seq_len >= 512 until autotune stabilizes.
Anna: OK. Next steps: run 48h canary, collect charts, reconvene Monday morning if noisy. :thumbsup:
